Character: CHIIKAWA HOWARD, the same cheerful 7-year-old boy as Howard (same face, same messy brown hair peeking out) but in casual clothes: a white knit beanie with two round bear ears (pink inner ears), a soft pink T-shirt with a tiny cute Chiikawa face print, light-blue shorts, white wristbands, white socks and pink-trimmed sneakers.
